# Brand Name

> One sentence: what the business/product is, for whom, and where it operates.

Optional short paragraph with the key facts an assistant should get right (pricing model, regions served, founding year, what you don't do).

## Key pages
- [Product / Services](https://example.com/services): what we offer
- [Pricing](https://example.com/pricing): plans and what's included
- [About](https://example.com/about): who we are, location, contact
